comments.value: Also having this problem with SDK2... have  already reduced texture size, detached my world ID in the scene descriptor, reimported the SDK, and of course restarted Unity. The world size is 228meg, unity package size is 1.3G.  Any updates on this?
@{5f2f8de0ed04fc68329d4399|full_name}: In the SDK builder settings Turn off "Future Proofing" and try the upload again.

Looks like the fix is to disable Future Proofing, as this uploads a copy of your unity package, which can be MUCH larger than the vrcw file.  This thread explains how to do that:  https://www.reddit.com/r/VRchat/comments/b1bd7f/help_cant_upload_avatar_says_future_proofing/

Was having same problem with publishing. I've been beating on this thing for a month, loading/unload assets, removing/changing shaders, etc. Now tried disabling Future Proofing and viola! Fixed! and it all comes down to one checkbox!
Thanks for the link, OhGeezCmon!
I guess one question that remains is why is my unitypackage file getting so big? My project does contain a lot of unused assets in it that are not in the Scene at all.
Congrats on finding a solution! Please let us know if you're still experiencing this issue on the latest SDK.
